result.topic_en: Defines d'(n) = d(n) - 2γ - log n and the constant C for partial sums of (2γ+log n)/√n, states that the sum of d'(n)/√n equals ζ(1/2)^2 - C, and manipulates a weighted divisor sum involving arcsin toward a Voronoi-type identity with e^{-2πω√q} and cos 2πω√q terms; a marginal note links it to the 'Voronoi identity'.
result.transcription:
Add MS a 94 18(109)   (109)
[-The constant in the series $\sum_{n=1}^{n=\infty}\frac{d(n)}{\sqrt{n}}$-]
Let $d'(n) = d(n) - 2\gamma - \log n$ and [-C be the constant in-] {+let+}
$\frac{2\gamma+\log 1}{\sqrt{1}} + \frac{2\gamma+\log 2}{\sqrt{2}} + \cdots\cdots + \frac{2\gamma+\log n}{\sqrt{n}}$
$= C + 2\sqrt{n}\,(\log n + 2\gamma - 2) + o(1)$.
Then $\sum_{n=1}^{n=\infty}\frac{d'(n)}{\sqrt{n}} = \{\zeta(\tfrac{1}{2})\}^2 - C.$

Connected with the 'Voronoi identity': I have somewhat similar formulae of my own T.O[?]

$\sum_{2\sqrt{n}<\omega} d(n)\left(1-\frac{\omega}{\pi\sqrt{n}}\right) + \sum_{2\sqrt{n}>\omega} d(n)\left\{\frac{2}{\pi}\sin^{-1}\frac{\omega}{2\sqrt{n}} - \frac{\omega}{\pi\sqrt{n}}\right\}$
$= \sum_{2\sqrt{n}<\omega} d(n) - \sum_{2\sqrt{n}<\omega} d'(n)\frac{\omega}{\pi\sqrt{n}} + \sum_{2\sqrt{n}>\omega} d'(n)\left\{\frac{2}{\pi}\sin^{-1}\frac{\pi}{2\sqrt{n}} - \frac{\omega}{\pi\sqrt{n}}\right\}$
$- \sum_{2\sqrt{n}<\omega}\frac{(2\gamma+\log n)\,\omega}{\pi\sqrt{n}} + \sum_{2\sqrt{n}>\omega}(2\gamma+\log n)\left\{\frac{2}{\pi}\sin^{-1}\frac{\pi}{2\sqrt{n}} - \frac{\omega}{\pi\sqrt{n}}\right\}$
$= \sum_{2\sqrt{n}<\omega} d(n) - \frac{\omega}{\pi}\left\{(\zeta(\tfrac{1}{2}))^2 - C\right\} + \sum_{2\sqrt{n}>\omega} d'(n)\cdot\frac{2}{\pi}\sin^{-1}\frac{\pi}{2\sqrt{n}}$
[-$=\frac{\omega}{\pi}\{C + 2\sqrt{n}(\log n$-] $- \frac{\omega}{\pi}\sum_{2\sqrt{n}<\omega}\frac{2\gamma+\log n}{\sqrt{n}}$
$+ \sum_{2\sqrt{n}>\omega}(2\gamma+\log n)\left\{\frac{2}{\pi}\sin^{-1}\frac{\pi}{2\sqrt{n}} - \frac{\omega}{\pi\sqrt{n}}\right\}$

$\sum_{2\sqrt{n}<\omega} d(n) + \frac{2}{\pi}\sum_{2\sqrt{n}>\omega} d'(n)\sin^{-1}\frac{\pi}{2\sqrt{n}} + \frac{\omega}{\pi}\left(C - \sum_{2\sqrt{n}<\omega}\frac{2\gamma+\log n}{\sqrt{n}}\right)$
$+ \sum_{2\sqrt{n}>\omega}(2\gamma+\log n)\left\{\frac{2}{\pi}\sin^{-1}\frac{\pi}{2\sqrt{n}} - \frac{\omega}{\pi\sqrt{n}}\right\}$
$= \frac{1}{2}\omega^2 + \frac{1}{4} - \frac{1}{2}\sum_{q=1}^{q=\infty}\frac{d(q)}{q}e^{-2\pi\omega\sqrt{q}} + \frac{1}{2}[?]\sum_{q=1}^{q=\infty}\frac{d(q)}{q}\cos 2\pi\omega\sqrt{q}$

methods.what: Asymptotic expansion defining the constant C for partial sums of (2γ+log n)/√n
Evaluation of the series of d'(n)/√n, with d'(n) = d(n) - 2γ - log n, in terms of ζ(1/2)^2 and C
Rewriting an arcsin-weighted divisor sum by splitting d(n) = d'(n) + (2γ + log n)
Voronoi-type identity expressing the weighted divisor sum through series of d(q)/q times e^{-2πω√q} and cos 2πω√q

items.english: Then the sum over n of d'(n)/√n equals ζ(1/2) squared minus C.
The combined weighted divisor-sum expression equals ½ω² + ¼ − ½ Σ d(q)/q e^{−2πω√q} + ½ Σ d(q)/q cos 2πω√q.
